note: IP-neutral. Heists (issue #306): rob an outpost's control room. Read by src/systems/flow/heist.gd. Issue #309: the console in every outpost's control room (src/systems/world/outpost_room.gd). Hold [E] at it for hack.seconds and it drops hack.stash (count of item) at your feet, picked up like a smuggling drop (contraband: the gate's search finds it). It only has something to release while a heist names that outpost (WorldState.heist); otherwise it is locked. reach: metres from the spot in front of the console. The alarm is not touched: being seen raises it as usual and the hack keeps going. Issue #310: the jobs are on the board (content/core/board/bar_board.json: j_heist, the locals' side; j_general_heist, the Remnant's, free roam only). 'cut': the crew's share of the pay, off the top. 'hack_standing': on the hack, the side you robbed thinks a little less of you (the locals' heist costs Remnant standing, the general's costs the locals'). 'paid_standing': what the side that paid thinks of it. 'crew': who goes with you, by side: a soldier profile (content/core/soldiers), an assassin droid's variant (borrowed: it follows and fights like one of yours but is not in your roster, and goes home after), and the crew member's card (content/core/npcs/heist_crew_card.json). They keep 'follow' metres behind you, catch up past 'catch_up' (out of sight past 'rejoin'), and only shoot whoever is fighting you, within 'range' (so sneaking works with them along). 'barks' are their lines over their head.

start: Right behind you. Keep it quiet till it isn't.

paid: That's my cut. See you around.
